behavior.validation: Accept exactly the required schema keys in plain passive JSON-compatible objects and dense ordinary arrays, with finite binary64 values and safe integer descriptors; no coercion, defaults, accessors, booleans-as-numbers or retained aliases. Complete static shape/value validation precedes work preflight. Geometric/topology tests run after preflight. Failure throws Error with stable code, no partial result. Outputs are detached. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0. Array lengths must fit 4294967295; unsafe requested growth/work arithmetic gives WORK_LIMIT before allocation. Host resource exhaustion is a host error, not an allocation guarantee. All grid/kernel/element dimensions are positive integers; each corresponding array length/product must fit 4294967295 and match exactly, otherwise INVALID_INPUT before work.
behavior.environment: No RNG, noise, time, rendering, assets, host state, mutation or retained aliases. Data uses caller coordinate/color conventions as specified.
behavior.numerics: Separate IEEE754 binary64 arithmetic, Math.hypot and host sin/cos/sqrt for the named formulas. Check computed numeric intermediates for finiteness and throw NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite results. No epsilon in classification or topology, no adaptive exact predicates or near-degeneracy guarantee. General scalar/coordinate comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; topology, indices, order, booleans and RNG states compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exact JSON output.
behavior.algorithm:
Input {points,widths,initialNormal,maxWork}; >=2 3D points, widths length equal, finite nonnegative full
widths, finite normal. Output {positions,indices}. Reject zero adjacent segment, exact reversal (unit
tangent dot exactly -1), and initial normal parallel to first tangent. Endpoint tangent is adjacent unit
segment; interior tangent normalizes adjacent unit sum. Orthogonalize initial normal. Transport with minimal
Rodrigues rotation, axis=normalized cross, sin=|cross|, cos=dot; same-direction copies. After every
transport, reorthogonalize normal against current tangent and normalize; failure is NUMERIC_OVERFLOW.
Positions are point +/- (width/2)*normal; faces [L,R,Rnext],[L,Rnext,Lnext]. Closed seam is excluded.
Work=24N+6(N-1). Fixtures: x-axis, width2 -> y +/-1; right angle is finite/orthogonal.
Studies: flight ribbons; folded contour paper.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export parallelTransportRibbon3D(input) from packages/javascript/src/parallel-transport-ribbon-3d.js. Other targets deferred.
behavior.frame_rules: A supplied zero adjacent segment, adjacent unit directions with dot exactly -1, or zero projected initialNormal is INVALID_INPUT. Compute interior point tangents as normalized sums of adjacent unit directions. For each new tangent, cross(previousTangent,currentTangent) supplies axis and sine; cosine is their dot. Zero cross with positive dot copies normal; a zero-cross reversal is INVALID_INPUT. Rodrigues vector rotation is n*cos + (axis cross n)*sin + axis*(axis dot n)*(1-cos), evaluated left-to-right per component. Reproject n-currentTangent*(n dot currentTangent), normalize by Math.hypot; zero or nonfinite generated frame is NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. Full widths produce plus first, minus second positions at each point; L=2*i,R=2*i+1. An input ending at its initial coordinate is still an open strip with independent endpoint frames; no seam closing/correction. Preflight output2*N positions and2*(N-1) faces.
